extract_resource_to_tempfile: extract a package resource to a temporary file and return the file path
extract_pex_resource: extract a resource from a pex zip package to a temporary file
get_resource_data: get binary data from a package resource using pkgutil and write it to a temp file
review_get_resource_tempfile: review the get_resource_tempfile function that handles both normal packages and pex archives
refactor_get_resource_tempfile: refactor get_resource_tempfile to support additional archive formats beyond pex
